information_updates.finding: LEN-99936 shows that server-management-controller firmware release notes should be ingested as a distinct security-maintenance feed; firmware provenance and minimum safe versions belong in Worldshepherd asset inventory, not only OS/package vulnerability tracking.

CVE-2024-39599 demonstrates a protection-mechanism failure where a configured malware-scanning control can be bypassed by application logic, reinforcing the need to test enforcement paths rather than merely verify that a security feature is configured.

GB/T 39599-2020 provides a civil/environmental terminology reference for low-impact-development stormwater management and harvesting, expanding Worldshepherd's built-environment/environmental systems vocabulary.

ATCC 99396 and Addgene 99936 provide chain-of-custody/licensing controls for biological research materials, useful as examples of how physical research assets require identity, handling, distribution and permitted-use metadata.
